sources.name: St. Thomas More Catholic Church
sources.coverage: Sparse historical source, not a consistent weekly or full-year panel. Counts cover the inspected visible year sections, not all sermons delivered.
sources.affiliation: The parish-hosted named homily archive and clergy listing associate him with this church; selected December 2022 text explicitly situates an upcoming penance service at St Thomas More.
sources.comparability: Parish hosting and explicit 2022 local reference establish affiliation. Selected 2025 PDF headers do not independently print church/place; hosting is affiliation evidence, not proof of exact delivery venue. Written texts presented as homilies; no audio/video was inspected, and word-for-word correspondence to actual delivery is unverified. Do not label them verified transcripts.

limits: The 24 historical Tally dates are not 24 newly matched sermons. Both target-year coverage fields remain unknown for all eight groups.
Current parish identity, current clergy role and historical event speaker are separate claims.
The two supplementary written sources are outside the eight roster reviews. They are not merged into the 150 historical entities or 86 supported identities.
49 PDF links were observed, and eight selected bodies were inspected for metadata and genre. No manuscript bodies, recordings or captions are hosted.
The November 30, 2022 cutoff is descriptive and does not establish AI use or non-use.
